items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: Sam Morgan I think had the best band at that time. ... Sam Morgan had the best band for a reading band

ctx.x: Who was the best trumpet players in those days that you liked best? At that time?

Yeah. Well, Sam Morgan I think had the best band at that time. Sam Morgan, then Rainey. And Sam Morgan had the best band for a reading band, you know. But a jazz band I think Buddy Petey used to draw a crowd and Rainey too.
How did Buddy Petey play? What style did he… Oh, he had a funny style.
